title: TechCrunch Mobility: The hidden human cost of robotaxis
summary: The article examines the human impact of robotaxis, including job displacement and societal costs often overlooked in discussions of autonomous vehicle technology advancement.
content: Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility, your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, the role AI is playing in it.

title: Caterpillar is bringing to AI deployment what it learned from automating mining
summary: Caterpillar is applying operational insights from decades of autonomous mining deployments to its enterprise AI strategy, demonstrating how industrial automation experience can accelerate AI integration in large organizations.
content: Caterpillar has spent decades putting autonomous machines to work at remote mining sites. It's now bringing that experience to AI deployment.

title: Chess.com launched a poker site and is planning even more classic games
summary: Chess.com launched Gambit, a free poker platform, and plans to expand into additional classic games, signaling a shift from focused chess specialization toward a broader games ecosystem.
content:
Chess.com has done one thing, and one thing very well, for almost 20 years, but now it's going beyond its domain name. The biggest name in online chess quietly launched its first companion site in beta back in May: Gambit, a free online poker website where players can learn the game without risking any real money. Now Gambit's ready to really get the ball rolling with its first livestreamed event and collaborations with content creators, and Chess.com is planning to branch out into even more games from here.

title: Inside Meta’s push to put robots to work in data centers
summary: Meta is testing robots to automate technician tasks in data centers, part of a broader industry trend toward robotic automation to reduce operational costs and labor intensity in infrastructure management.
content: The company is testing robots on tasks that can performed by technicians.

zh.summary: Meta正在测试机器人以自动化数据中心的技术人员任务，这是行业更广泛的趋势的一部分，旨在通过机器人自动化来降低运营成本和基础设施管理中的劳动力密集度。
